title: Track 11 — rezzy-recon: MSC4521 GF(2^64) PinSketch Reconciliation, h64 Prefix Grinding & MSC4511 Causal Tries (0.6.0-rc.1)
public_safety_audit_summary: High (Liveness / DoS): The local no-amplification retry policy caps bandwidth amplification under h64 prefix grinding, but permits targeted subtree liveness starvation and 128-slot per-round queue saturation. Moderate (Algebraic Floor): Keeping GF(2^64) properly avoids a 4–7x CPU DoS multiplier on Frobenius root finding, leaving a 2^32 offline birthday collision floor and ~2^37 XOR residual forgery bound. Moderate (Crypto Agility): MSC4511 v2 leaf-compressed causal tries specify both SHA-256 and BLAKE3 (v3) domain-separated tags and require strict u64 checked-addition count verification.
